stock.description: Bortex Global Limited operates as an investment holding company with a core business focused on the design, production, and distribution of light-emitting diode (LED) illumination products. The company serves a diverse international market, including Canada, the United States, the People's Republic of China, and Hong Kong. Its comprehensive product line includes an extensive selection of LED decorative and string lights, featuring straight-line, icicle, beard garland, crab, wreath, flower, meteor shower, sphere, net, and smart string lights, alongside specialized toy and tree light series. Additionally, Bortex Global provides LED commercial lighting solutions such as tube lights, ceiling lamps, and standard light bulbs, as well as offerings within its LED solar system series. The firm caters to a varied clientele, encompassing retailers, wholesalers, property developers, various other industries, and agricultural technology companies. Established in 2014, Bortex Global Limited's corporate headquarters are located in Kwun Tong, Hong Kong.
